entries.name: claude-code-mods (karanb192)
entries.author: karanb192
entries.description: A mod-builder skill plus mods for pinning subagent models, keeping the prompt cache warm and peeking at images.

plugins.name: image-peek
plugins.description: Preview pasted images at their prompt markers on macOS. Ghostty, plus experimental iTerm2 and Herdr support with a startup override. Reach L2: local clipboard capture and temporary files, no model or network calls.

plugins.name: mod-builder
plugins.description: A skill that plans, writes, validates, proves, reviews, migrates and publishes Claude Code mods. Plan first with the smallest $ surface, a footprint diffed against the plan, a test seen failing, an isolated load that leaves evidence files, a five-line threat model, and a handoff that names what was and was not proven. Brainstorm mode checks ideas against every mod already on GitHub.

via: 'npx -y -p typescript tsc (no tsc on PATH; the first typecheck downloads TypeScr

plugins.name: fable-pin
plugins.description: Pins every subagent to the fable model by rewriting agent.spawn, with /fable-pin on, off and status. Reach L0: its own store and one command, nothing else.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: cache-tax, the Mod. Stops a cold send once with its price, keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set (/keepwarm 6h), arms that for you after a paid cold write, and keeps score. Reach L2, one $.model.fork per idle stretch, its own store, a status slot; sees prompt length only.

acknowledge.runtime-fetch: mod-builder's typecheck step runs npx -y -p typescript tsc when tsc isn't installed. It runs on demand inside the skill, not from a hook.
